question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
SELECT c.name as constructor_name, cy.year, cy.combined
FROM (
    SELECT fc.constructor_id, fc.year, fc.constructor_points, bd.best_driver_points, 
           fc.constructor_points + bd.best_driver_points as combined,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fc.constructor_points + bd.best_driver_points DESC) as rn
    FROM (
        SELECT cs.constructor_id, lr.year, cs.points as constructor_points
        FROM constructor_standings cs
        JOIN (SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id FROM races GROUP BY year) lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    ) fc
    JOIN (
        SELECT drv_constructor_id as constructor_id, year, MAX(driver_points) as best_driver_points
        FROM (
            SELECT ds.driver_id, lr.year, ds.points as driver_points, d.constructor_id as drv_constructor_id
            FROM driver_standings ds
            JOIN (SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id FROM races GROUP BY year) lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
            JOIN drives d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id AND lr.year = d.year
        )
        GROUP BY drv_constructor_id, year
    ) bd ON fc.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id AND fc.year = bd.year
) cy
JOIN constructors c ON cy.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE cy.rn <= 3
ORDER BY cy.combined DESC

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Now let's find the best driver per constructor per year by looking at final standings
-- We need to join driver_standings with drives to know which constructor a driver was with

-- Get the final race_id for each year
WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
-- Get final constructor standings (season totals)
final_constructor AS (
    SELECT cs.constructor_id, lr.year, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_race lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
-- Get final driver standings with constructor info
final_driver AS (
    SELECT ds.driver_id, lr.year, ds.points as driver_points, d.constructor_id as drv_constructor_id
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_race lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN drives d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id AND lr.year = d.year
),
-- Find best driver per constructor per year
best_driver AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, year, MAX(driver_points) as best_driver_points
    FROM final_driver
    GROUP BY constructor_id, year
)
-- Join constructor points with best driver points
SELECT fc.constructor_id, fc.year, fc.constructor_points, bd.best_driver_points, 
       fc.constructor_points + bd.best_driver_points as combined
FROM final_constructor fc
JOIN best_driver bd ON fc.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id AND fc.year = bd.year
ORDER BY combined DESC
LIMIT 10"}
